title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: NADIA'S MINI GOLF
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Nadia Brooks, a blackjack dealer in Reno, Nevada.
She never bets on anything.
Then she bet everything on an old mini golf course.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE EMPTY LOT
segments.quote: Thus fear of danger is ten thousand times more terrifying than danger itself.
segments.author: Daniel Defoe
lines: Across her street sat Putt Paradise, closed for twenty years. Weeds and a rusty windmill.
Nadia wanted to rent it and fix it. But what if it failed?
Her grandpa's old Robinson Crusoe had one line underlined, from Daniel Defoe:
Thus fear of danger is ten thousand times more terrifying than danger itself.
So she called the owner and rented it.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE HAWAII MONEY
segments.quote: The desire for safety stands against every great and noble enterprise.
segments.author: Tacitus
lines: Fixing it would cost eight thousand dollars. Her Hawaii money.
Her brother Marcus said, Keep it safe.
Her old boss Lou texted her a line from the Roman historian Tacitus:
The desire for safety stands against every great and noble enterprise.
So Nadia bought green carpet instead of plane tickets.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE WINDMILL
segments.quote: Everything is theoretically impossible, until it's done.
segments.author: Robert A. Heinlein
lines: Hole nine had a windmill that had not turned in twenty years.
Three repairmen said it was impossible.
Marcus, a science fiction fan, read her a line from Robert Heinlein:
Everything is theoretically impossible, until it's done.
So they hooked a bicycle chain to an old washing machine motor. It turned.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE LAWN CHAIRS
segments.quote: Nature is not a temple but a workshop, and man is the workman in it.
segments.author: Ivan Turgenev
lines: Neighbors watched from lawn chairs and said, That lot is nature now.
Miss Odette, a retired librarian, laughed and read a line from the Russian writer Ivan Turgenev:
Nature is not a temple but a workshop, and man is the workman in it.
Nadia handed her gloves. By Saturday, twenty neighbors were pulling weeds.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE UGLY HOLE
segments.quote: Beauty is no quality in things themselves: it exists merely in the mind which contemplates them.
segments.author: David Hume
lines: Everyone painted a hole. Hole six got a purple dinosaur with three eyes.
Nadia thought it was the ugliest thing in Nevada.
Miss Odette stopped her with a line from the Scottish thinker David Hume:
Beauty is no quality in things themselves: it exists merely in the mind which contemplates them.
The dinosaur stayed. Now people line up for pictures with it.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: OPENING NIGHT
segments.quote: Ask yourself whether you are happy, and you cease to be so.
segments.author: John Stuart Mill
lines: On opening night, Nadia kept checking. Is this working?
Lou handed her a putter and a line from the English thinker John Stuart Mill:
Ask yourself whether you are happy, and you cease to be so.
So she stopped asking and just played.
She hit a hole in one through the windmill, and the whole street cheered.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Face the fear. Take the risk. Try the impossible. Get to work. Keep the dinosaur. Play.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Face the fear. Take the risk. Try the impossible. Get to work. Keep the dinosaur. And just play.
I play mini golf too. Last time, the windmill won.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
